attchmntText: Integrated Financial Results for the Quarter ended 30-09-2026
voiceSummary: Country Club Hospitality and Holidays Limited approved its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting held on November 12, 2026. The standalone net profit for the quarter was Rs. 23.10 Lakhs, compared to Rs. 3.64 Lakhs in the same period last year. Consolidated net profit stood at Rs. 32.65 Lakhs versus Rs. 13.39 Lakhs previously. The company appointed Mr. Y. Siddharth Reddy, Vice Chairman, JMD and CEO, as the Nodal Officer under Section 125 of the Companies Act 2013. The financial statements were reviewed by M/s. P. Murali and Co., Chartered Accountants. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 1,161.16 Lakhs on a standalone basis.
